name: std::make_error_condition(std::future_errc)
intro:
Constructs an std::error_condition object from a value of type std::future_errc as if by:

std::error_condition(static_cast<int>(e), std::future_category()).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A value of type std::error_condition that holds the error code number from e associated with the error category "future".

summary: Constructs an std::error_condition object from a value of type std::future_errc as if by:

recommendedExamples.output:
Caught a future_error with code "future:3"
Message: "No associated state"
